indication: Edema in adult patients with chronic heart failure (CHF) or chronic kidney disease (CKD)
headline: FUROSCIX ReadyFlow (furosemide) Autoinjector approved as the first and only autoinjector delivering IV-equivalent diuretic therapy for edema in adults with chronic heart failure or chronic kidney disease, two days ahead of its PDUFA goal date (Jul 24 2026).
pdufa_note: The PDUFA goal date was July 26, 2026. The FDA approved on July 24, 2026, two days early.
